overall_notes: The paper is well-extracted overall. Key findings: (1) The paper introduces NEO-BENCH benchmark for evaluating LLM robustness to neologisms across multiple NLG tasks. (2) Uses both automatic metrics and human evaluation extensively. (3) GPT-4 is used as an evaluator for definition generation task. (4) Human evaluation follows a detailed MQM-derived framework for translation quality assessment. The extraction was quite accurate with minor normalization needed.
